title: Daily Omega-3 & Cognitive Decline Prevention
raw_claim: Daily high-dose Omega-3 supplementation (2000mg EPA/DHA) completely prevents cognitive decline and reverses early-stage Alzheimer's disease in adults over 65.

sub_claims.text: Daily high-dose Omega-3 (2000mg EPA/DHA) reduces plasma biomarkers associated with neuroinflammation.
sub_claims.original_claim_segment: Daily high-dose Omega-3 supplementation (2000mg EPA/DHA) reduces neuroinflammation
sub_claims.boundary_gap_description: Supported by biomarker measurements (p-tau181 reduction) in 12-week clinical trials.

sub_claims.text: Supplementation completely prevents age-related cognitive decline.
sub_claims.boundary_gap_description: UNSUPPORTED BOUNDARY GAP: Absolute prevention claims contradict meta-analyses showing no significant difference in MMSE cognitive scores at 2 years.

sub_claims.text: Omega-3 supplementation reverses existing early-stage Alzheimer's disease structural pathology.
sub_claims.boundary_gap_description: REFUTED BOUNDARY GAP: Neuroimaging studies confirm amyloid plaque accumulation and brain atrophy are unaffected by fatty acid supplementation.

evidence.source_title: Effects of High-Dose Omega-3 Fatty Acids on Inflammatory Biomarkers in Mild Cognitive Impairment
evidence.quote_snippet: Administration of 1.7g DHA + 0.6g EPA daily for 6 months suppressed CSF interleukin-6 and reduced plasma inflammatory markers in ApoE4 non-carriers.

evidence.source_title: Long-term Omega-3 Supplementation and Cognitive Function in Older Adults: Cochrane Systematic Review
evidence.authors: Sydenham, E., Dangour, A. D., & Lim, W. S.
evidence.quote_snippet: Direct comparison across 43 RCTs revealed no statistically significant prevention of dementia onset or slowdown in Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) score decline.

evidence.source_title: Amyloid-PET Imaging Outcomes in ApoE4 Carriers Under Omega-3 Therapy
evidence.quote_snippet: DHA supplementation failed to slow the rate of brain atrophy on volumetric MRI or reduce cortical amyloid-beta burden in mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's disease.

ebdf_deltas.delta_scope: Evidence studied ApoE4 non-carriers with mild impairment; Claim expands scope to universal prevention and treatment for all Alzheimer's patients.
ebdf_deltas.delta_certainty: Evidence reports minor biomarker modulation in CSF; Claim elevates this to 'completely prevents' and 'reverses' structural disease.
ebdf_deltas.delta_temporal: Evidence evaluated 6-month to 2-year trial windows; Claim asserts permanent disease reversal.
ebdf_deltas.delta_causal: Claim assumes biomarker lowering equals functional clinical reversal, ignoring irreversible neurodegenerative cell loss.

stress_test_results.attack_hypothesis: Test if CSF inflammatory reduction leads to measurable MMSE score improvement.
stress_test_results.original_evidence_holding: Biomarker modulation observed in ApoE4 non-carriers.
stress_test_results.attacked_condition: Standard clinical MMSE cognitive evaluation scores.
stress_test_results.breaking_point_explanation: FAILED: Biomarker lowering does not translate into measurable cognitive preservation or symptom reversal.

stress_test_results.attack_hypothesis: Test if supplementation provides any benefit to ApoE4 allele carriers (high risk group).
stress_test_results.attacked_condition: ApoE4 homozygous subjects with high baseline amyloid load.
stress_test_results.breaking_point_explanation: FAILED: Zero therapeutic effect observed in ApoE4 carriers, breaking the universal claim scope.

stress_test_results.attack_hypothesis: Test if Omega-3 clears established beta-amyloid plaques or tau tangles.
stress_test_results.breaking_point_explanation: FAILED: Amyloid-PET imaging conclusively shows no plaque clearance or reversal.

fragility.explanation_summary: Extremely fragile claim. Modest biomarker modulation in small sub-studies has been exaggerated into an unproven claim of complete Alzheimer's prevention and reversal.

verdict_justification: Large-scale meta-analyses and PET neuroimaging trials explicitly refute claims of Alzheimer's disease reversal or complete cognitive decline prevention.
boundary_summary: Evidence boundary ends at temporary anti-inflammatory biomarker modulation in ApoE4 non-carriers. Clinical prevention and reversal claims are contradicted by empirical data.
killer_questions: What Phase III trial demonstrates statistically significant MMSE score improvement from Omega-3 monotherapy?
Why does the claim state 'reverses Alzheimer's' when Quinn et al. PET imaging proved zero amyloid plaque reduction?
How does the claim address the lack of efficacy in ApoE4 gene carriers?
missing_evidence_requirements: Phase III double-blind RCT showing cognitive scale improvement (ADAS-Cog) sustained over 5+ years.
Neuroimaging data proving structural reduction in tau tangles or beta-amyloid burden.
Replicated trial demonstrating efficacy across both ApoE4 positive and negative genotypes.
evidence_mutations: Source quote 'suppressed CSF interleukin-6' exaggerated into 'completely prevents cognitive decline'.
Source quote 'failed to slow rate of brain atrophy' inverted into 'reverses early-stage Alzheimer's'.
